svg.title: Repair app full-stack architecture
svg.desc: Three-tier architecture: React client apps at top, NestJS backend modules in middle, data layer at bottom

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What pages does the customer-facing React app need?')
sendPrompt('What pages does the admin panel need?')
sendPrompt('How do I implement the Auth module in NestJS with JWT and role guards?')
sendPrompt('How do I structure the Booking module in NestJS?')
sendPrompt('How do I structure the Technician module in NestJS?')
sendPrompt('How do I integrate Stripe or Razorpay in NestJS?')
sendPrompt('How do I implement notifications in NestJS for SMS, email and push?')
sendPrompt('What analytics should the repair service admin dashboard show?')
sendPrompt('What is the PostgreSQL schema for the repair service app?')
sendPrompt('How should Redis be used in the repair service app?')
sendPrompt('Which external APIs are needed for the repair service app?')
